result.summary: Micro-amendment M1AMEND-20261119-01 written into the four blocks of docs/requirements.yaml, only what decisions/0122 О5/О6 and decisions/0123 decided, each block with one dated comment line «was -> now» above it. REQ-109 criterion 1: the one `rewrites` rule and the folder entries with a trailing slash are replaced by the measured forms of spike S1 (the explicit `routes` table of app/vercel.json in four rules — the header rule for every path with continue, the files, one rule /api and /api/<path> -> /api/index?__p=<path>, a terminal 404 to /404.html — with no rewrites, headers, redirects, cleanUrls, trailingSlash or builds beside it; the allowlist folders without a trailing slash, `/*` first), with the S1 evidence and the damaged copies that app/test/unit/vercel-config.test.js holds. REQ-109 criterion 8: «the output then equals app/public byte for byte» is replaced for the open build by the public set of REQ-111 criterion 9 from the build of REQ-111 (R1.2) on (О3); the closed output now names one file index.html with the bytes of public/gate.html, a second run of the same build on that output (exit 0, nothing changed) and the fail-closed refusal of every other closed run (the fix d87b3d1). REQ-108 criterion 11: its two literals (the `paths` list and the jobs) gain, from the build of REQ-111 on, the four paths of REQ-111 guard row (8) and the job e2e of REQ-111 criterion 11 (О3 as widened by step 01c issue I5). REQ-111 criterion 12: the overflow rule reads, for every visible text node that is not only white space, its nearest ancestor whose computed display is not inline, the .sr elements and their descendants left out (V2). REQ-112: the frame sentence and criterion 5 gain «a tap that changes the drawn state with no walk draws exactly one frame; a tap to the state already drawn draws none» and criterion 5 the mutant «no frame on a state change with no walk» (О15, V1); criterion 6 reads «no two labels overlap» when «Вы» stands, at load and after each walk (V3); criterion 4 names the neutral constant of the code design, NEUTRAL_COLOUR #808080 and NEUTRAL_STRENGTH 0, with what the test asserts (V4); fact (10) reads 7 green twins (V5). Every other word, criterion, title, owner, status, depends_on and original_request is unchanged (a field by field comparison of the parsed YAML), the rest of the file has the same sha256 before and after, the YAML loads with 112 blocks; no criterion weakened. Places that still state the pre-S1 form or an old count but are not named by the records are left as they are and raised in issues I5-I9.
